doc: Overkill on killable targets (U1 B4, Qwen review 02 §5): a rifle squad 44 m from a stationary rifle squad of 6 HP units (two 3-damage hits each), for 30 s. Overkill is measured from the shot trace: hits that dealt nothing because the victim was already dead that tick. The dummies are killable here, unlike the unkillable dummies of dps_orders, so the overkill figure means something. Gate: every dummy dies in the run. The overkill figure is reported (null), not graded: it is the number the owner's targeting questions (U1Q2, Prowess) need.

attack_move.doc: Attack-move to the dummy's position instead of attacking the squad.

probes.doc: Every dummy dies within the 30 s.
Reported: distinct victims, most shots at one, and overkill (hits on a dead victim).
